steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each short part is placed by the job's start and the part's expected arrival.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 job has a short part with no expected arrival

findings.title: Part short for a job with no expected arrival
findings.fix: Get an arrival date from purchasing today

findings.title: Arrival after the job's start date
findings.fix: Re-sequence the job or expedite the part

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] job-1042.md:12  Part short for a job with no expected arrival.
       Fix: Get an arrival date from purchasing today.
[medium] job-1044.md:19  Arrival after the job's start date.
       Fix: Re-sequence the job or expedite the part.
[low] job-1046.md:26  Shortage with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Supplier reliability.
pros: Checks a part short for a job with no expected arrival, and an arrival after the job's start date.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-material-shortages skill on the records for this review.
